answer: Cross-Epoch Behavioural Fingerprinting. Each identity is scored on a fixed feature vector (action mix, counterpart overlap, session cadence) computed per epoch; agents whose vectors remain close across epochs are trusted, while sharp discontinuities trigger quarantine. A comet of activity in one epoch must cohere with the wharf of prior history and the jetty of later behaviour. Sybils that clone an honest profile fail when their divergence is measured over multiple epochs.
